conclusions: Positive-diagonal QR is global and smooth on GL_r(C); its upper-entry factor changes by right multiplication under right N_r. The proposed cutoff has exact upper-root integral one and cuts arbitrary compact families modulo N_r to compact sets, including rank zero.

The two radical integrals are nonzero because their characters have positive real part near identity. The exact left and right Jacquet disintegrations give kappaL*kappaR, with the conjugated right character, the original radical Haar measure and the normalized residual compact and trivial-unipotent masses.

The open chart maps the compact cut support into the original positive Gram domain with a margin. Its root-coordinate disintegration introduces no unretained determinant or scalar. Both compact representation factors cancel by the stated covariance.

Localization by the leading determinant is equality on an open neighborhood of the entire fixed-head orbit; it preserves the values of Theta and all leading-minor differential words, not merely the undifferentiated coefficient.

The inverse spectral factors act in the already constructed actual terminal Capelli algebra. The explicit displayed start includes the original sign (-1)^(k-l0); its inverse on the prescribed set is finite interpolation on the common compact types. Thus every actual frame-word entry is local and preserves compact supports. No abstract finite-dimensional replacement is made.

The original restricted lower-root quotient for every block head has compact support after Gaussian recovery from a fixed compact representative. The support is uniform on compact positive terminal neighborhoods, permitting all finite terminal differential operators to pass through the integral.

The regular radial comparison has exactly product_j |c_j|^(2*(r-j)+k). FrameTransportToLastLevel preserves the original six scalar multipliers and Lie directions and intertwines all signed words with their actual tensor ordering. The complete CutEXAsm comparison at lines 443-471 matches the displayed proof.

The original IsTopLift2 and InDDplus2 are retained. The actual differential representative of Theta(F1) extends compactly by zero across the Gram boundary because its support has a positive margin. DensC then transfers equality of regular radial transforms to every orbital vector.
Appending the last singleton uses the original highest-unipotent root disintegration and prescribed embedded frames. Rank zero reduces to the same normalized compact average.

The exact terminal weight is |zeta|^2/(|zeta|^2-T*Tprime), independent of the head. The original signed rational word recursion and cut conditions make its type eigenvalue the square of the original dH. Type completeness is invoked only on the compact-stabilizer-fixed orbital vectors; orthogonality then gives precisely the original weighted Hilbert-Schmidt Gram expression.
The final covariance argument extends the D-frame identity to every original positive last-level group element. Empty words, all relevant block heads and every original admissible word are retained.
